sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是百分之九十九的隐形。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Back in February of 2012, Miguel Ordenana went on a hike in Los Angeles' famous Griffith Park.
sentences.zh: 早在2012年2月，米格尔·奥尔德纳纳去洛杉矶著名的格里菲斯公园徒步。

sentences.en: The trail he took led him to a hill that looks out over the Hollywood Bowl and the Ford Amphitheater.
sentences.zh: 他走的小径通往一座小山，从那里可以俯瞰好莱坞露天剧场和福特露天剧场。

sentences.en: It was one of my favorite spots to collect data from because I would get these really beautiful photos of animals
sentences.zh: 这是我最喜欢收集数据的地方之一，因为我能拍到非常漂亮的动物照片

sentences.en: because I had this beautiful view of the sky in L.A.
sentences.zh: 因为洛杉矶天空的视野非常美丽。

sentences.en: Miguel is a wildlife biologist who studies animals inside the city of Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 米格尔是一位野生动物生物学家，专门研究洛杉矶市内动物。

sentences.en: As a kid, he and his mom lived in a duplex in Los Feliz on the south side of Griffith Park.
sentences.zh: 小时候，他和妈妈住在格里菲斯公园南侧洛斯费利兹的一栋复式公寓里。

sentences.en: That's producer Roxandra Guidi.
sentences.zh: 那是制作人罗克珊娜·圭迪。

sentences.en: On his hike, Miguel walked through canyons of dark green chaparral,
sentences.zh: 在徒步时，米格尔穿梭于深绿色硬叶灌木丛的峡谷中，

sentences.en: collecting footage from a set of motion-activated trail cameras.
sentences.zh: 从一套运动触发式红外相机中收集影像。

sentences.en: He used the trail cams as part of his research for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他使用这些红外相机作为美国森林管理局研究工作的

sentences.en: Forest Service,
sentences.zh: 一部分，

sentences.en: monitoring the animals that called the park home.
sentences.zh: 监测以公园为家的动物们。

sentences.en: When he got back to his office, Miguel started sorting through the images.
sentences.zh: 回到办公室后，米格尔开始整理这些图像。

sentences.en: Usually what my brain kind of gets used to is it's like seeing a bunch of like empty photos
sentences.zh: 通常我的大脑习惯看到的一堆像是一堆空照片

sentences.en: because grass often triggers my camera or a bunch of deer and rabbit photos.
sentences.zh: 因为草丛经常会触发我的相机，或者拍到一堆鹿和兔子的照片。

sentences.en: Every now and then, his cameras would pick up other animals too, like coyotes.
sentences.zh: 偶尔，他的相机也会拍到其他动物，比如郊狼。

sentences.en: Maybe even a gray fox if I'm lucky because I just learned that gray foxes were in the park as well.
sentences.zh: 如果幸运的话，甚至可能有一只灰狐，因为我刚得知公园里也有灰狐。

sentences.en: But this time around, he didn't see any coyotes or foxes.
sentences.zh: 但这一次，他没有看到任何郊狼或狐狸。

sentences.en: Instead, he saw something even more extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 相反，他看到了更非同寻常的东西。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, I get this big puma butt on my computer screen and I'm just blown away.
sentences.zh: 突然间，我的电脑屏幕上出现了一个巨大的美洲狮屁股，我简直惊呆了。

sentences.en: I literally jump out of my seat.
sentences.zh: 我情不自禁地从座位上跳了起来。

sentences.en: A puma butt.
sentences.zh: 美洲狮的屁股。

sentences.en: I'm in shock and it's, I even go back a few photos and come back to it just to kind of refresh my eyes
sentences.zh: 我处于震惊之中，而且，我甚至回看了几张照片，然后又切回来，只是为了清醒一下眼睛

sentences.en: to make sure it's not a Great Dane because often people will walk their dogs in front of my camera
sentences.zh: 确保这不是一只大丹犬，因为人们经常在我的相机前遛狗

sentences.en: and that's a big animal.
sentences.zh: 而且那是一只很大的动物。

sentences.en: But this was obviously a puma, which is also commonly called a cougar or a mountain lion.
sentences.zh: 但这显然是一只美洲狮，通常也被称为美洲狮或山狮。

sentences.en: It had a shiny coat of sandy brown fur, muscular legs, huge furry paws.
sentences.zh: 它有着沙棕色闪亮的皮毛、肌肉发达的腿、巨大的毛茸茸的爪子。

sentences.en: And there's also even this little black marking, which is left by males as scent marking residue
sentences.zh: 而且甚至还有一个小小的黑色标记，这是雄性留下气味标记的残留物

sentences.en: that only males produce.
sentences.zh: 只有雄性才会产生。

sentences.en: So not only did I know it was a mountain lion, but we were able to confirm that it was a male
sentences.zh: 所以不仅我知道这是一只美洲狮，而且我们能够确认它是一只雄性

sentences.en: just by this butt photo.
sentences.zh: 仅仅通过这张屁股照片。

sentences.en: Mountain lions are classified as a specially protected species, not quite endangered, but close.
sentences.zh: 美洲狮被列为特别保护物种，虽然还算不上濒危，但也差不多了。

sentences.en: There are somewhere between 2,000 and 6,000 of them spread across the foothills and mountains
sentences.zh: 在加利福尼亚州的山麓和山脉中，大约有2000到6000只

sentences.en: of California.
sentences.zh: 美洲狮。

sentences.en: But here was a mountain lion in a municipal park that's used by thousands of people every day
sentences.zh: 但这里竟然有一只美洲狮，生活在一个每天有数千人使用的城市公园里

sentences.en: in one of the largest, most congested cities in the country.
sentences.zh: 位于这个国家最大、最拥挤的城市之一。

sentences.en: This was like finding Bigfoot.
sentences.zh: 这就像发现了大脚怪。

sentences.en: This was like finding La Chupacabra or some sort of urban legend like that.
sentences.zh: 这就像发现了卓柏卡布拉或某种类似的都市传说。

sentences.en: As he stared at the puma's butt on his computer screen, Miguel couldn't help but wonder,
sentences.zh: 当他盯着电脑屏幕上美洲狮的屁股时，米格尔不禁在想，

sentences.en: how on earth did this mountain lion end up here?
sentences.zh: 这只美洲狮到底是怎么到这里来的？

sentences.en: Where did he come from?
sentences.zh: 它是从哪里来的？

sentences.en: How did he get there?
sentences.zh: 它是怎么到那里的？

sentences.en: What's going to happen next?
sentences.zh: 接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: What's going to happen to this mountain lion?
sentences.zh: 这只美洲狮会怎么样？

sentences.en: Is he going to try and escape and get by a car?
sentences.zh: 它会试图逃跑然后被车撞吗？

sentences.en: There was a good chance something like that could happen.
sentences.zh: 发生这种事的可能性很大。

sentences.en: Across the state, traffic accidents are the leading cause of mountain lion death.
sentences.zh: 在全州范围内，交通事故是美洲狮死亡的首要原因。

sentences.en: And yet somehow, this one had miraculously survived the trek across L.A.'s busiest highways.
sentences.zh: 然而不知何故，这只美洲狮奇迹般地在穿越南加州最繁忙的高速公路的长途跋涉中存活了下来。

sentences.en: Researchers say it's the first documented case of a cougar making it this far into the
sentences.zh: 研究人员表示，这是有记录以来第一只深入到

sentences.en: urban core without getting run over and killed.
sentences.zh: 城市核心区而没有被撞死的美洲狮。

sentences.en: But now he was effectively stuck, surrounded on all sides by an ocean of freeways and crowded
sentences.zh: 但现在它实际上被困住了，四面八方都被一片高速公路和拥挤的

sentences.en: neighborhoods.
sentences.zh: 居民区所包围。

sentences.en: Wildlife and urban development don't usually go well together.
sentences.zh: 野生动物与城市开发通常无法和谐共存。

sentences.en: Roads in particular fracture the habitats of wide-ranging animals.
sentences.zh: 尤其是道路，分割了广阔活动范围的动物的栖息地。

sentences.en: It restricts their movements and makes it harder for them to find food or a mate.
sentences.zh: 这限制了它们的活动，使它们更难找到食物或配偶。

sentences.en: However, in the years since Miguel first discovered Griffith Park's mountain lion,
sentences.zh: 然而，自从米格尔首次发现格里菲斯公园的美洲狮以来的几年里，

sentences.en: biologists and urban planners have started working together,
sentences.zh: 生物学家和城市规划师开始合作，

sentences.en: crafting a plan to try to help pumas move more safely around the city.
sentences.zh: 制定计划，试图帮助美洲狮在城市中更安全地活动。

sentences.en: And in the process, this one cat has turned into something of a celebrity.
sentences.zh: 在这个过程中，这只猫科动物已经变成了某种名人。

sentences.en: The symbol of a movement to redesign our cities and make the built environment more friendly
sentences.zh: 重新设计我们的城市并让建筑环境对动物更友好的运动的

sentences.en: to animals.
sentences.zh: 象征。

sentences.en: Morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: Morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: I met up with Miguel this past winter on the edge of Griffith Park.
sentences.zh: 今年冬天，我在格里菲斯公园边缘见到了米格尔。

sentences.en: A decade later, the mountain lion still calls this place home.
sentences.zh: 十年过去了，这只美洲狮仍然以这里为家。

sentences.en: And he has a name now, P-22.
sentences.zh: 它现在有了名字，P-22。

sentences.en: It's catchy.
sentences.zh: 很顺口。

sentences.en: I like it.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢。

sentences.en: Super catchy.
sentences.zh: 超级顺口。

sentences.en: P-22 stands for Puma No.
sentences.zh: P-22代表22号
美洲狮。

sentences.en: It was given to him by the National Park Service, which for the past 20 years has been
sentences.zh: 这个名字是国家公园管理局给它的，在过去的20年里，该机构

sentences.en: tracking more than 100 other mountain lions across Southern California.
sentences.zh: 一直在追踪南加州的其他100多只美洲狮。

sentences.en: Just after Miguel's discovery, the Park Service captured and tagged P-22 with a GPS collar.
sentences.zh: 就在米格尔发现它后不久，公园管理局就捕获了P-22并给它戴上了GPS项圈。

sentences.en: By following his movements, they've been able to get a better sense of his health,
sentences.zh: 通过追踪它的行动，他们能够更好地了解它的健康状况、

sentences.en: the size of his territory, and his ability to reproduce.
sentences.zh: 领地大小以及繁殖能力。

sentences.en: They did match his genetics with a male that they studied, who is his dad, P-1, which stands
sentences.zh: 他们将它的基因与他们研究过的一只雄性进行了匹配，那是它的父亲P-1，代表

sentences.en: for Puma 1.
sentences.zh: 美洲狮1号。

sentences.en: And he was the first Puma ever studied by the National Park Service.
sentences.zh: 它是国家公园管理局研究的第一只美洲狮。

sentences.en: And he was a vicious individual, like the big, one of the biggeSt...
sentences.zh: 它是一个凶猛的家伙，就像那只大的，其中最大的一只……

sentences.en: For years, P-22's dad, P-1, was the dominant male cougar in the Santa Monica Mountains.
sentences.zh: 多年来，P-22的父亲P-1一直是圣莫尼卡山脉中占主导地位的雄性美洲狮。

sentences.en: He fathered litters of cubs with the female mountain lions who roamed his territory.
sentences.zh: 它与其领地内游荡雌性美洲狮繁育了一窝又一窝的幼崽。

sentences.en: But when he couldn't find a mate, he started mating with his offspring.
sentences.zh: 但当它找不到配偶时，它开始与自己的后代交配。

sentences.en: Low genetic diversity is a problem among all mountain lions in the Santa Monica Mountains.
sentences.zh: 遗传多样性低是圣莫尼卡山脉所有美洲狮都面临的问题。

sentences.en: P-1 was also fiercely territorial.
sentences.zh: P-1也有极强的领地意识。

sentences.en: When his cubs started taking up a lot of his space, he started killing his offspring.
sentences.zh: 当它的幼崽开始占据它的大量空间时，它开始杀死自己的后代。

sentences.en: It's possible that P-22 survived his father's wrath by making this unlikely journey to Griffith Park.
sentences.zh: P-22可能是通过这趟前往格里菲斯公园的不寻常旅程，才在父亲的愤怒中幸存下来的。

sentences.en: So, I know, basically, his favorite hangouts and spots, which are trails, funnels, canyons, intersections and trails,
sentences.zh: 所以，我基本上知道它最喜欢去的地方和据点，比如小径、漏斗形峡谷、峡谷、交叉路口和小径，

sentences.en: places where you see scat tracks, or these other signs called scrapes, where they, like, kick through their back feet like this.
sentences.zh: 在那里你会看到粪便足迹，或者其他被称为刮痕的迹象，它们会像这样用后脚向后踢。

sentences.en: We might see some up there.
sentences.zh: 我们可能在上面看到一些。

sentences.en: Miguel is kicking up the dirt gently with his feet, so I can try to picture these scrapes.
sentences.zh: 米格尔用脚轻轻踢起泥土，以便我能试着想象这些刮痕。

sentences.en: And now I'm looking for signs of a cougar on our trail, checking the ground for scat.
sentences.zh: 现在我在我们的山路上寻找美洲狮的迹象，检查地面上是否有粪便。

sentences.en: There's a part of me that wants to see P-22, but a bigger part does not.
sentences.zh: 我内心有一部分渴望见到P-22，但更大一部分并不想。

sentences.en: He blends in so well, so quiet and silent, that he just can be right over there.
sentences.zh: 它完美地融入环境，如此安静无声，以至于它可能就在那边。

sentences.en: But even if he is right over there, he's likely to stay hidden in the park's deep canyons and caves.
sentences.zh: 但即使它真的就在那边，它也可能会藏在公园幽深的峡谷和洞穴里。

sentences.en: Mountain lions may come off as ferocious in our imaginations, but in reality, they're actually pretty timid.
sentences.zh: 在我们的想象中，美洲狮可能显得很凶猛，但实际上，它们其实相当胆小。

sentences.en: They're not like the big cats like leopards and African lions and jaguars that are a little bit more bold and fierce.
sentences.zh: 它们不像豹子、非洲狮和美洲虎那样的大猫，那些更大胆、更凶猛。

sentences.en: They're a little bit like your cat that is a little bit like a scaredy cat, basically.
sentences.zh: 它们有点像你的猫，基本上就是有点像胆小鬼。

sentences.en: In the last decade, there's been no evidence of other mountain lions coming into P-22's territory,
sentences.zh: 在过去的十年里，没有证据表明有其他美洲狮进入P-22的领地，

sentences.en: partly because they, too, would have to survive the treacherous journey from the Santa Monica Mountains across Interstate 405 and Highway 101.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是它们也必须在从圣莫尼卡山脉穿过405号州际公路和101号公路的危险旅程中幸存下来。

sentences.en: But also because Griffith Park is small.
sentences.zh: 但也是因为格里菲斯公园很小。

sentences.en: The typical range of a male mountain lion is 150 square miles, but P-22 has only nine square miles to work with.
sentences.zh: 雄性美洲狮的典型活动范围是150平方英里，但P-22只有9平方英里的活动空间。

sentences.en: And that's a problem, because if P-22 wants to find a mate, he'd have to retrace his steps,
sentences.zh: 这是一个问题，因为如果P-22想找一个配偶，它就必须原路返回，

sentences.en: facing busy freeways in neighborhoods or stepping into another cougar's territory.
sentences.zh: 面对居民区繁忙的高速公路，或者闯入另一只美洲狮的领地。

sentences.en: Do you know if he's attempted to leave the park and go back to the Santa Monica Mountains?
sentences.zh: 你知道它是否试图离开公园返回圣莫尼卡山脉吗？

sentences.en: No, but he, well, I don't know what he was thinking, but one time he actually crossed Barham Boulevard,
sentences.zh: 没有，但是，好吧，我不知道它当时是怎么想的，有一次它竟然穿过了巴勒姆大道，

sentences.en: which is bordering us with Universal.
sentences.zh: 那是我们与环球影城接壤的边界。

sentences.en: That's Universal Studios.
sentences.zh: 那是环球影城。

sentences.en: Apparently, someone saw P-22 literally crossing the street and reported it.
sentences.zh: 显然，有人看到P-22真的在过马路并进行了报告。

sentences.en: But anyway, he crossed over, went actually into the back lot where they do the tram tours and all that,
sentences.zh: 但无论如何，它穿了过去，实际上进入了他们拍摄电车游览等内容的后场，

sentences.en: and spent the night and didn't like what he experienced.
sentences.zh: 并在那里过夜，而且不喜欢它所经历的一切。

sentences.en: P-22 has actually left Griffith Park a number of times.
sentences.zh: P-22其实已经离开过格里菲斯公园好几次了。

sentences.en: He's been spotted roaming around the Hollywood Hills and some other well-to-do neighborhoods surrounding the park.
sentences.zh: 人们曾发现它在好莱坞山以及公园周围的一些富人区游荡。

sentences.en: In fact, he's become something of a local celebrity.
sentences.zh: 事实上，它已经成了某种当地的名人。

sentences.en: Angelina knows love to track his whereabouts.
sentences.zh: 天使之城的居民喜欢追踪它的行踪。

sentences.en: Nearby residents like hearing about sightings of P-22 and believe he may have ventured out of Griffith Park because of the heat.
sentences.zh: 附近的居民喜欢听到关于P-22目击事件的消息，并认为它可能是因为炎热才冒险离开格里菲斯公园的。

sentences.en: I found him drinking from a sprinkler head that was kind of dripping down onto the sidewalk.
sentences.zh: 我发现它正在喝洒水喷头滴到人行道上的水。

sentences.en: Experts who track and study P-22.
sentences.zh: 追踪和研究P-22的专家们。

sentences.en: Even Stitcher's own VP of content and our show's boss, Colin Anderson, had his own run-in with LA's favorite mountain lion.
sentences.zh: 甚至Stitcher自己的内容副总裁兼我们节目的老板科恩·安德森，也与洛杉矶最受欢迎的美洲狮有过一次偶遇。

sentences.en: I looked up and P-22 was about 10 feet away from me.
sentences.zh: 我抬头一看，P-22离我只有大约10英尺远。

sentences.en: And one thing I was really aware of was that I was wearing sandals.
sentences.zh: 我真正意识到的一件事是我穿着凉鞋。

sentences.en: And I was like, this isn't optimal.
sentences.zh: 当时我想，这可不太妙。

sentences.en: My shorts and my sandals, like, ugh, not dressed for a mountain lion confrontation.
sentences.zh: 我的短裤和凉鞋，天哪，这打扮不适合与美洲狮对抗。

sentences.en: Still, at the end of his adventures, P-22 always ends up coming back to Griffith Park.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，在它的历险结束时，P-22总是会回到格里菲斯公园。

sentences.en: From one of the peaks in Griffith Park, about 1,600 feet, you can get a lay of the surrounding land.
sentences.zh: 从格里菲斯公园大约1600英尺的一个山峰上，你可以鸟瞰周围的土地。

sentences.en: To the south, the Los Feliz and Silver Lake neighborhoods with sleek palm trees in the distance.
sentences.zh: 向南望去，是洛斯费利兹和银湖社区，远处是线条流畅的棕榈树。

sentences.en: To the east is the concrete channel of the LA River, which runs along Interstate 5, one of the busiest freeways in California.
sentences.zh: 东面是洛杉矶河的混凝土河道，它沿着加州最繁忙的高速公路之一5号州际公路延伸。

sentences.en: And to the north and west is the famous Hollywood sign.
sentences.zh: 向北和向西是著名的好莱坞标志。

sentences.en: And another highway, the 101, which runs all the way out to the coaSt.
sentences.zh: 还有另一条高速公路，即一路延伸到海岸的101国道。

sentences.en: From up here, you can see that P-22 really is marooned on this island.
sentences.zh: 从这里往上看，你可以看到P-22真的被困在了这个孤岛上。

sentences.en: But it wasn't always like that.
sentences.zh: 但情况并非一直如此。

sentences.en: The hills of Griffith Park are part of the Santa Monica mountain range.
sentences.zh: 格里菲斯公园的山丘是圣莫尼卡山脉的一部分。

sentences.en: It's just that developments and major roadways have chewed up large swaths of land.
sentences.zh: 只是开发项目和主要道路蚕食了大片土地。

sentences.en: People build to the absolute maximum and then think about wildlife, think about the repercussions later.
sentences.zh: 人们把开发做到极致，然后才考虑野生动物，考虑之后的后果。

sentences.en: The island effect isn't some natural occurrence.
sentences.zh: 岛屿效应并不是什么自然现象。

sentences.en: It's the result of a series of decisions made over decades.
sentences.zh: 它是几十年间作出一系列决定的结果。

sentences.en: A recent study found that if urban development continues as it has, mountain lions could disappear in Southern California within the next 50 years.
sentences.zh: 最近的一项研究发现，如果城市开发照此继续下去，美洲狮可能会在未来50年内在南加州消失。

sentences.en: The demise of such an important apex predator would have a downstream effect on the entire ecosystem.
sentences.zh: 如此重要的顶级掠食者的消亡将对整个生态系统产生连锁反应。

sentences.en: For me, P-22, like for a lot of people, was an entry into not just socially changing my thinking, but scientifically.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，P-22就像对很多人一样，不仅是在思想上改变了我，在科学认知上也让我有了入门。

sentences.en: Like I just had really not been exposed to the science of connectivity.
sentences.zh: 就像我之前真的没有接触过连通性科学一样。

sentences.en: Beth Pratt is the California Regional Executive Director for the National Wildlife Federation.
sentences.zh: 贝丝·普拉特是国家野生动物联合会加州区域执行主任。

sentences.en: She's a big fan of P-22, even has a tattoo of the mountain lion's face on her shoulder.
sentences.zh: 她是P-22的超级粉丝，甚至在肩膀上纹了美洲狮脸部的纹身。

sentences.en: Around the time P-22 was discovered, Beth came to L.A.
sentences.zh: 在P-22被发现前后，贝丝来到洛杉矶

sentences.en: to research her book, When Mountain Lions Are Neighbors.
sentences.zh: 为她的书《当美洲狮是邻居》搜集资料。

sentences.en: She met up with a puma expert from the National Park Service who took her around town.
sentences.zh: 她遇到了国家公园管理局的一位美洲狮专家，后者带她参观了整个城市。

sentences.en: We drove around the Santa Monica Mountains and he's pointing out these freeways and talking about the other cats that lived there.
sentences.zh: 我们开车绕着圣莫尼卡山脉行驶，他指出这些高速公路并谈论了在那里生活的其他猫科动物。

sentences.en: And I was like, wow, this is, you know, this is a problem.
sentences.zh: 当时我想，哇，你知道的，这是一个问题。

sentences.en: And it also occurred to me, this is fixable.
sentences.zh: 我也突然意识到，这是可以解决的。

sentences.en: Beth thought there must be a way to restitch the landscape to make sure no other mountain lion would have to cross multiple freeways in order to roam and find a mate.
sentences.zh: 贝丝认为，一定有一种方法可以重新缝合这片土地，确保没有其他美洲狮为了四处游荡和寻找配偶，而不得不穿过多条高速公路。

sentences.en: She spoke with other wildlife experts about the problem, but no one had a concrete solution.
sentences.zh: 她与其他野生动物专家讨论过这个问题，但没有人拿出具体的解决方案。

sentences.en: They knew they needed something to help with connectivity.
sentences.zh: 他们知道自己需要一些东西来帮助实现生态连通。

sentences.en: Was it a tunnel?
sentences.zh: 是一条隧道吗？

sentences.en: Was it fencing?
sentences.zh: 是围栏吗？

sentences.en: Was it an overpass?
sentences.zh: 是一座天桥吗？

sentences.en: Beth and her colleagues weren't going to turn sprawling Southern California into a safe mountain lion habitat all at once.
sentences.zh: 贝丝和她的同事们并不打算一下子把不断扩张的南加州变成一个安全的美洲狮栖息地。

sentences.en: But they needed to start somewhere.
sentences.zh: 但他们总得从某个地方开始。

sentences.en: So she joined forces with other local wildlife organizations and launched a campaign called Save L.A.
sentences.zh: 于是，她与当地其他野生动物组织联手，发起了一场名为“拯救洛杉矶美洲狮”的运动。

sentences.en: Cougars.
sentences.zh: 美洲狮。

sentences.en: The group planned to raise awareness and do more research on the local mountain lion population.
sentences.zh: 该组织计划提高公众意识，并对当地的美洲狮种群进行更多研究。

sentences.en: But their main goal was to build a massive, first of its kind, urban wildlife crossing.
sentences.zh: 但他们的主要目标是建造一座规模庞大、前所未有的城市野生动物过街天桥。

sentences.en: Wildlife crossings are physical structures that help animals safely navigate human-made barriers like highways.
sentences.zh: 野生动物通道是一种实体结构，可以帮助动物安全穿过高速公路等人造屏障。

sentences.en: Often they're built in places where roadways cut through dense forests and other open land.
sentences.zh: 它们通常建在道路穿过茂密森林和其他开阔地带的地方。

sentences.en: Crossings have been shown to both reduce animal vehicle crashes and relink territories that different species call home.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，这些通道既能减少动物与车辆的碰撞，又能重新连接不同物种赖以生存的领地。

sentences.en: They typically come in the form of an underpass or an overpass and have been used widely in Europe for decades.
sentences.zh: 它们通常以地下通道或过街天桥的形式出现，在欧洲已经使用了几十年。

sentences.en: More recently, they've started taking off in North America.
sentences.zh: 最近，它们开始在北美流行起来。

sentences.en: In Canada's Banff National Park, a network of wildlife crossings are used every day by bears, wolves, moose, elk, and yes, mountain lions.
sentences.zh: 在加拿大的班夫国家公园，熊、狼、驼鹿、北美马鹿，以及没错，还有美洲狮，每天都在使用这样一个野生动物通道网络。

sentences.en: Proving that a thoughtfully designed crossing in places where species tend to migrate can benefit humans and wildlife.
sentences.zh: 这证明了在物种迁徙的必经之地上，精心设计的动物通道可以同时造福人类和野生动物。

sentences.en: However, a wildlife overpass in a megacity like Los Angeles had never been done before.
sentences.zh: 然而，像洛杉矶这样的大都市里修建野生动物过街天桥还是破天荒头一遭。

sentences.en: Politicians in particular were skeptical, not just about the utility of an urban wildlife crossing, but its price tag.
sentences.zh: 政客们尤其持怀疑态度，不仅怀疑城市野生动物通道的实用性，还怀疑它的造价。

sentences.en: This would be the biggest and most expensive crossing in the world, spanning 10 lanes of highway.
sentences.zh: 这将是世界上最大、最昂贵的动物通道，横跨10车道的高速公路。

sentences.en: The California Department of Transportation had tried to get federal funding for a project like this three times in the past and failed.
sentences.zh: 加州交通局过去曾三次试图为此类项目争取联邦资助，但都失败了。

sentences.en: Initially, even Beth struggled to sell the idea of a wildlife crossing to her higher-ups.
sentences.zh: 起初，就连贝丝也很难向上级推销野生动物通道的想法。

sentences.en: I had a boss when I started it who, you know, I presented and they were like,
sentences.zh: 我刚开始做这个项目时有个老板，你知道的，我做完陈述后，他们的反应是：

sentences.en: what?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: What's a wildlife crossing?
sentences.zh: 什么是野生动物通道？

sentences.en: What does that do?
sentences.zh: 那有什么用？

sentences.en: How is that scalable?
sentences.zh: 这怎么能规模化推广？

sentences.en: The Save LA Cougars campaign needed to make it easier for people to get on board with their project.
sentences.zh: “拯救洛杉矶美洲狮”运动需要让人们更容易接受他们的项目。

sentences.en: They needed to help people understand the importance of wildlife conservation inside the city itself,
sentences.zh: 他们需要帮助人们认识到在城市内部开展野生动物保护的重要性，

sentences.en: to give Angelenos a clear reason to support the crossing.
sentences.zh: 为洛杉矶人支持这座过街天桥提供一个明确的理由。

sentences.en: They needed P-22.
sentences.zh: 他们需要P-22。

sentences.en: Listen, it's no accident, you know, this is LA and LA loves their celebrities and worships them.
sentences.zh: 听着，这绝非偶然，你知道的，这里是洛杉矶，洛杉矶人热爱名人并崇拜他们。

sentences.en: And here's this cat that literally lives under the Hollywood sign.
sentences.zh: 而这里有一只猫，它居然就住在好莱坞标志下方。

sentences.en: He's handsome.
sentences.zh: 它很帅气。

sentences.en: He's, you know, challenged with his dating life.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，它的约会生活有些坎坷。

sentences.en: It is a made-for-Hollywood movie.
sentences.zh: 这简直是为好莱坞量身打造的电影剧本。

sentences.en: Since his discovery, Angelenos have gotten to know P-22.
sentences.zh: 自从被发现以来，洛杉矶人就逐渐认识了P-22。

sentences.en: With every passing encounter, he was less a fearsome mountain lion prowling Griffith Park
sentences.zh: 随着一次次与它相遇，它越来越不像一只在格里菲斯公园四处游荡、令人畏惧的美洲狮，

sentences.en: and more of a neighbor, someone you might run into as you take out your trash or go out on a morning walk.
sentences.zh: 而更像是一个邻居，一个你在倒垃圾或早晨散步时可能会碰巧遇到的人。

sentences.en: Save LA Cougars used that recognition to get people to care about the crossing.
sentences.zh: “拯救洛杉矶美洲狮”运动利用这种知名度来让人们关心这座过街天桥。

sentences.en: The campaign also helped build a narrative around P-22.
sentences.zh: 这场运动还围绕P-22构建了一个故事。

sentences.en: He was the young cub, struck out on his own, and by some stroke of luck, survived crossing two major highways.
sentences.zh: 它曾是一只年轻的幼崽，独自闯荡，凭借某种运势，历经千难万险穿过了两条主要高速公路。

sentences.en: He then landed in Los Angeles' most famous park, where he himself became famous.
sentences.zh: 随后，它来到了洛杉矶最著名的公园，并在那里变得家喻户晓。

sentences.en: Except, now he was isolated, alone even, needing to find a way back out.
sentences.zh: 只不过，现在它被孤立了，甚至可以说是形单影只，需要找到一条出路。

sentences.en: It was a story people could connect to, and many did.
sentences.zh: 这是一个能让人产生共鸣的故事，许多人也确实做到了。

sentences.en: His story just resonates compared to any other animals.
sentences.zh: 与任何其他动物相比，它的故事更能引起共鸣。

sentences.en: No other story is bigger than this one.
sentences.zh: 没有任何一个故事比这个更大。

sentences.en: Starting in 2016, the Save LA Cougars campaign organized an all-day festival in Griffith Park called P-22 Day.
sentences.zh: 从2016年开始，“拯救洛杉矶美洲狮”运动在格里菲斯公园组织了一场全天的节日，名为“P-22日”。

sentences.en: There, Angelenos can sign up for group hikes along parts of P-22's 40-mile trek.
sentences.zh: 在那里，洛杉矶人可以报名参加沿着P-22长达40英里迁徙路线部分路段的团体徒步活动。

sentences.en: Festival-goers can even buy P-22 swag, like a onesie or a tow bag.
sentences.zh: 节日参与者甚至可以购买P-22的周边商品，比如连体婴儿服或托特包。

sentences.en: And most importantly, they can donate to the Wildlife Crossing.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，他们可以为野生动物通道捐款。

sentences.en: The campaign held their most recent event just last month.
sentences.zh: 就在上个月，该运动举办了他们最近的一次活动。

sentences.en: Well, what I love about P-22 is that he reflects the struggles of finding a mate in the urbanized area of Los Angeles,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我喜欢P-22的一点是，它反映了在洛杉矶这个城市化地区寻找伴侣的挣扎，

sentences.en: which I feel like I face the same struggles.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我也面临着同样的挣扎。

sentences.en: Initially, Beth felt a little strange about all of this.
sentences.zh: 起初，贝丝对这一切感到有点奇怪。

sentences.en: She and her campaign succeeded in making people care about LA's mountain lions.
sentences.zh: 她和她的运动成功让人们开始关心洛杉矶的美洲狮。

sentences.en: But it wasn't the science that brought them in.
sentences.zh: 但吸引人们加入进来的并不是科学。

sentences.en: It was P-22's celebrity.
sentences.zh: 而是P-22的名气。

sentences.en: The campaign was anthropomorphizing P-22, which is something that scientists usually try to steer clear of.
sentences.zh: 这场运动将P-22拟人化了，这是科学家通常尽量避免的事情。

sentences.en: Listen, there are people who hate my approach to the campaign.
sentences.zh: 听着，有人讨厌我开展这场运动的方法。

sentences.en: They hate anthropomorphizing.
sentences.zh: 他们讨厌拟人化。

sentences.en: Even people in my own organization, like I'm committing heresy with some of these, you know, traditional scientists.
sentences.zh: 甚至我所在组织内部的人也觉得，在某些传统科学家看来，我简直是在离经叛道。

sentences.en: I'm really curious about that.
sentences.zh: 我对此真的很好奇。

sentences.en: Is that part of kind of a, just like an old school, like you do not need to, yeah, anthropomorphize or like tell me a story?
sentences.zh: 这算是一种老派的做法吗？比如，你不需要……对，把动物拟人化，或者讲故事？

sentences.en: Like we should strictly follow, follow the science and hope that the funding comes through.
sentences.zh: 就像我们应该严格遵循科学，然后祈祷资金能够到位一样。

sentences.en: So I think there's just a lot of people were just educated in that very hard science mode and they have a hard time with anthropomorphizing.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得很多人受到的都是那种非常硬核的科学教育，他们很难接受拟人化。

sentences.en: But turning a puma into a character has gotten results.
sentences.zh: 但把一只美洲狮变成一个有血有肉的角色确实取得了成效。

sentences.en: The campaign to build the wildlife crossing has raised more than $105 million from foundations and private donations.
sentences.zh: 修建野生动物通道的筹款运动已经从基金会和私人捐款中筹集了超过1.05亿美元。

sentences.en: A lot of it on the back of P-22's story.
sentences.zh: 其中很大一部分都要归功于P-22的故事。

sentences.en: The whole thing has been a success beyond Beth and her colleagues' wildest imaginations.
sentences.zh: 整个项目的成功超出了贝丝和她同事们最疯狂的想象。

sentences.en: Welcome everybody watching to the groundbreaking for the Wallace-Annenberg Wildlife Crossing.
sentences.zh: 欢迎各位观众来到华莱士-安嫩伯格野生动物通道的动工仪式。

sentences.en: Work on the crossing actually began earlier this year.
sentences.zh: 通道的建设工作实际上在今年早些时候就已经开始了。

sentences.en: Beth spoke from the site above a section of the 101 freeway, an area that P-22 may have crossed himself on his way to Griffith Park.
sentences.zh: 贝丝在101高速公路某一河段上方的现场发表了讲话，P-22在前往格里菲斯公园的途中可能就曾横穿过这片区域。

sentences.en: And we are so honored to be here and celebrating with you all who looked at this impossible dream and like me said, not on my watch.
sentences.zh: 我们非常荣幸能来到这里，与在座各位共同庆祝，你们看到了这个看似不可能实现的梦想，并像我一样说：绝不在我眼皮底下发生。

sentences.en: We are not going to let this mountain lion population go extinct on our watch.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不让这个美洲狮种群在我们眼皮底下灭绝。

sentences.en: The backdrop of her speech was a reminder of just what a mountain lion is up against, a non-stop stream of cars and trucks.
sentences.zh: 她演讲的背景时刻提醒着人们，美洲狮正在面临怎样的阻碍——川流不息的汽车和卡车。

sentences.en: The highway itself runs parallel to the Santa Monica Mountains, separating it from the Simi Hills and the larger Los Badgers National Forest to the north.
sentences.zh: 这条高速公路与圣莫尼卡山脉平行，将其与北部的锡米山以及面积更大的洛斯帕德雷斯国家森林隔开。

sentences.en: This stretch of road is the biggest obstacle for mountain lions who want to find more mates and more land.
sentences.zh: 对于想要寻找更多配偶和更大领地的美洲狮来说，这段公路是最大的障碍。

sentences.en: And because the crossing is in a major city, designers and landscape architects have their work cut out for them to encourage animals to give the bridge a try.
sentences.zh: 由于该通道位于大城市内，设计人员和景观建筑师面临着艰巨的任务，他们要想方设法鼓励动物们尝试这座桥梁。

sentences.en: The team is talking to experts on light pollution, fungi, ecological restoration, fencing and even sound design.
sentences.zh: 团队正在与光污染、真菌、生态修复、围栏甚至声音设计方面的专家进行交流。

sentences.en: When it's done, it'll be 210 feet long and 175 feet wide.
sentences.zh: 建成后，它将长210英尺，宽175英尺。

sentences.en: So, yeah, there's a lot of technique we know how to mimic the habitat and attract them there.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我们有很多技术知道如何模仿栖息地并吸引它们来到这里。

sentences.en: You know, one of the reasons ours is so wide is, again, you have to make the animals feel like they're not on the highway.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们的通道之所以这么宽的原因之一是，再次强调，你必须让动物觉得它们不是在高速公路上。

sentences.en: So you can't just put like a we get asked, why can't you just do four feet and save money?
sentences.zh: 所以你不能只建一个……我们经常被问到，为什么不只建四英尺宽来省钱呢？

sentences.en: Well, a couple animals might use it, but you need it to look like the landscape.
sentences.zh: 嗯，可能会有几只动物使用它，但你需要它看起来就像自然景观。

sentences.en: So like for every foot long, there's a ratio.
sentences.zh: 所以，比如每增加一英尺的长度，都有一个比例。

sentences.en: It has to be, you know, that much more wide.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，它必须相应地宽出那么多。

sentences.en: And once a few animals check out the crossing and see that it works, more of them will follow.
sentences.zh: 一旦有几只动物查看了这座通道并发现它确实管用，就会有更多的动物效仿。

sentences.en: Word literally gets out in the animal world.
sentences.zh: 消息在动物界真的是一传十、十传百。

sentences.en: A few weeks back, I went out to the site of the crossing to get a feel for the landscape.
sentences.zh: 几周前，我去了通道的选址实地考察，去感受一下那里的地形。

sentences.en: So this is the site of the future Liberty Canyon Wildlife Crossing in Agora Hills.
sentences.zh: 这里就是阿戈拉山未来的自由峡谷野生动物通道的所在地。

sentences.en: This is actually the famous neighborhood of the Kardashians.
sentences.zh: 这里其实是卡戴珊家族著名的社区。

sentences.en: I don't know which Kardashians, but maybe Kim, Kylie.
sentences.zh: 我不知道具体是哪个卡戴珊，但可能是金、凯莉吧。

sentences.en: Those are the only two I know.
sentences.zh: 这是我仅知道的两个。

sentences.en: I was wrong.
sentences.zh: 我猜错了。

sentences.en: The Kardashians live about 15 minutes east from here.
sentences.zh: 卡戴珊家族住在距离这里以东大约15分钟车程的地方。

sentences.en: But anyway, you get the idea.
sentences.zh: 但不管怎样，你大概明白意思了。

sentences.en: This is there's a lot of open space.
sentences.zh: 这里有很多开阔的空间。

sentences.en: You can see the Santa Monica Mountains.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到圣莫尼卡山脉。

sentences.en: It's gorgeous out here.
sentences.zh: 这里风景美极了。

sentences.en: I asked Kat Superfisky to join me at the construction site for this crossing.
sentences.zh: 我邀请卡特·苏佩菲斯基和我一起去这个通道的施工现场。

sentences.en: She's as cool as her last name, as fun to say.
sentences.zh: 她和她的姓氏一样酷，念起来也很有趣。

sentences.en: She's also a designer and educator in the city of L.A.'s first urban ecologiSt.
sentences.zh: 她同时也是一名设计师和教育家，是洛杉矶市的首位城市生态学家。

sentences.en: We're hiking past a deep trench that starts at the edge of the site and creeps up the hill.
sentences.zh: 我们正沿着一条深沟徒步，这条深沟从工地边缘开始，一直延伸到山坡上。

sentences.en: This is one end of that future bridge, an area where wild animals are known to cross anyway
sentences.zh: 这是未来那座桥的一端，野生动物历来都会从这个区域穿过，

sentences.en: and where they would typically run into fast-moving cars.
sentences.zh: 而它们通常也会在这里撞上飞驰的汽车。

sentences.en: Even from where we're standing right here, you see the clear linkage.
sentences.zh: 甚至从我们现在站的这个地方，你就能看到清晰的生态连接。

sentences.en: You know, we're standing on one kind of mountain, mountainous area.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们正站在某种山地、山峦区域上。

sentences.en: We're looking down to another one.
sentences.zh: 我们正俯瞰着另一个山头。

sentences.en: If you're an animal, you're going to want to connect to that other, the hillsides.
sentences.zh: 如果你是一只动物，你会想要连接到那边的山坡上。

sentences.en: And so they would, again, you know, make it up to the 101 freeway,
sentences.zh: 所以它们又会，你知道的，一路来到101高速公路，

sentences.en: and then they would have no option other than to cross it to get to the other side.
sentences.zh: 然后它们别无选择，只能穿过高速公路才能到达另一边。

sentences.en: And right now we're providing pretty challenging conditions for them to hop across that like Frogger.
sentences.zh: 而现在，我们为它们提供了非常具有挑战性的条件，让它们像玩《青蛙过河》游戏一样跳过去。

sentences.en: It's good to think of this as a funnel of sorts.
sentences.zh: 把这里想象成某种漏斗是个不错的思路。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Really.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And that's why this site was chosen.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么选择这个地址。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 一点没错。

sentences.en: Yeah, when the National Park...
sentences.zh: 是的，当国家公园……

sentences.en: P-22 and Kat arrived in the city around the same time.
sentences.zh: P-22和卡特大约在同一时间来到这座城市。

sentences.en: And back then, she just wasn't aware of the possibilities of humans coexisting with nature,
sentences.zh: 而在那个时候，她根本没有意识到人类能够与自然共存的可能，

sentences.en: with wildlife, in a place like Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 能够与野生动物在洛杉矶这样的大都市里共存。

sentences.en: I showed up thinking that there wasn't going to be a lot of nature in L.A.,
sentences.zh: 我来到这里时，以为洛杉矶不会有很多大自然，

sentences.en: and that I was going to be starting kind of from, you know, the concrete itself.
sentences.zh: 而且我将不得不从混凝土本身开始着手。

sentences.en: And so, you know, it took me a couple years to really change the way that I saw a place like L.A.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我花了几年时间才真正改变了我对洛杉矶这种地方的看法。

sentences.en: And I practiced a lot peeling back the concrete and the steel and infrastructure
sentences.zh: 我进行了大量的实践，剥离混凝土、钢材和基础设施，

sentences.en: and kind of crossing my eyes and staring at the landscape around me and saying,
sentences.zh: 眯起眼睛凝视着周围的风景，然后对自己说：

sentences.en: okay, I can still actually kind of see the mountains.
sentences.zh: 好吧，其实我还是能隐约看到群山。

sentences.en: The topography and the landform is still there.
sentences.zh: 地形和地貌依然还在。

sentences.en: There is a great irony in all this.
sentences.zh: 这一切之中存在着一个巨大的讽刺。

sentences.en: Despite all the effort, we have no way of knowing whether P-22 will actually use this bridge.
sentences.zh: 尽管付出了所有的努力，我们还是无法知道P-22是否真的会使用这座桥。

sentences.en: The Agora Hills are about 25 miles west of Griffith Park.
sentences.zh: 阿戈拉山在格里菲斯公园以西大约25英里处。

sentences.en: Scientists say that as an older puma, he's likely to play it safe,
sentences.zh: 科学家说，作为一只年龄较大的美洲狮，它很可能会选择稳妥行事，

sentences.en: stay put, and accept his fate as a forever bachelor.
sentences.zh: 待在原地，接受自己终身做单身汉的命运。

sentences.en: But we do know that many, many other animals will use that crossing.
sentences.zh: 但我们确实知道，许多许多其他的动物将会使用这座过街天桥。

sentences.en: Foxes, bobcats, deer, and other mountain lions looking to find a mate or more space to call their own.
sentences.zh: 狐狸、短尾猫、鹿，以及其他想要寻找伴侣或更多领地的美洲狮。

sentences.en: Beth and Miguel both acknowledged that they used P-22 to try to do something bigger.
sentences.zh: 贝丝和米格尔都承认，他们利用P-22是为了尝试做一件更伟大的事情。

sentences.en: To begin to stitch the fragmented habitat of Los Angeles back together.
sentences.zh: 重新缝合洛杉矶破碎的生态栖息地。

sentences.en: To get Angelenos to start thinking of their city as an ecosystem.
sentences.zh: 让洛杉矶人开始把他们的城市看作是一个生态系统。

sentences.en: And these days, it's not just scientists and environmentalists who want to talk about P-22.
sentences.zh: 如今，不仅仅是科学家和环保主义者想要谈论P-22。

sentences.en: One mother told me her son, he thinks P-22 is a superhero.
sentences.zh: 一位母亲告诉我，她的儿子认为P-22是个超级英雄。

sentences.en: And he runs around the house with a cape and saying, you know, I'm P-22 and I'm going to...
sentences.zh: 他披着斗篷在屋里跑来跑去，嘴里念叨着，你知道的，我是P-22，我要去……

sentences.en: Like, it's that fundamental connection that is less about science that I am hopeful about.
sentences.zh: 这种超越科学层面的根本联系，正是我所寄予希望的地方。

sentences.en: Because I think L.A.
sentences.zh: 因为我认为洛杉矶的

sentences.en: kids especially, they know these cats like they know football players.
sentences.zh: 孩子们，尤其是他们了解这些美洲狮就像了解橄榄球运动员一样。

sentences.en: For all we know, P-22 is living a humble and relatively happy mountain lion life in his municipal park.
sentences.zh: 就我们所知，P-22正过着简朴且相对快乐的美洲狮生活，安于它的城市公园中。

sentences.en: But unknowingly, he's got us on the same page about something important.
sentences.zh: 但不知不觉中，它让我们的目标在一个重要问题上达成了一致。

sentences.en: Not just the need to build a huge wildlife crossing in Los Angeles, but the need for coexistence, for connectivity.
sentences.zh: 不仅需要在洛杉矶建造一座巨大的野生动物通道，更需要实现人与自然的共存与生态连通。

sentences.en: So that in a big city like L.A., you, me, P-22 and all the other urban dwelling wild animals can all feel a little less alone.
sentences.zh: 这样在洛杉矶这样的大城市里，你、我、P-22以及所有其他生活在城市的野生动物，都能感到不那么孤单。

sentences.en: When we come back, a wildlife crossing in action.
sentences.zh: 休息过后，我们将带您直击野生动物通道的运作。

sentences.en: All right, I'm back with our producer, Rooksandra Guidi.
sentences.zh: 好的，我回到了我们的制片人鲁克桑德拉·圭迪身边。

sentences.en: Rooks, you have one more thing that you want to share with us about these wildlife crossings?
sentences.zh: 鲁克斯，关于这些野生动物通道，你还有什么想和我们分享的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I have one more quick and kind of a silly thing.
sentences.zh: 对，我还有一个简短且有点傻乎乎的内容。

sentences.en: Except I know I'm not the only one who geeks out on this stuff.
sentences.zh: 不过我知道，为这种事情着迷的人可不止我一个。

sentences.en: So I'm going to have you open up this clip and watch it with me.
sentences.zh: 所以我要请你打开这段视频，和我一起看看。

sentences.en: It's really short.
sentences.zh: 真的很短。

sentences.en: So we'll just play the whole clip.
sentences.zh: 所以我们直接播放完整片段。

sentences.en: OK, so it's a it's a coyote jumping through a tunnel and it seems to be playing with a badger and trying to get it to follow it down the tunnel.
sentences.zh: 好的，画面是一只郊狼从隧道里跳过去，它似乎在和一只獾玩耍，并试图让獾跟着它进隧道。

sentences.en: Is that what I'm seeing?
sentences.zh: 我看到的是这样吗？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: It's like these two buddies are meeting up by the end of the tunnel.
sentences.zh: 就像这两个好基友在隧道尽头碰面了一样。

sentences.en: And I just love how excited the coyote is.
sentences.zh: 我特别喜欢这只郊狼兴奋的样子。

sentences.en: He looks just like a dog when he spots his leash somewhere and he's ready to go for a walk.
sentences.zh: 它看起来就像一只狗，当它发现某处的牵引绳时，就知道要出去散步了。

sentences.en: Totally, totally.
sentences.zh: 完全是这样，完全是。

sentences.en: This is so great.
sentences.zh: 这真是太棒了。

sentences.en: So what is going on in this clip?
sentences.zh: 那么这段视频里到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, it went viral about two years ago.
sentences.zh: 嗯，大约两年前它在网上疯传。

sentences.en: And what I love about it is that the tunnel they are merrily strolling through, it's actually a wildlife crossing.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的一点是，它们欢快漫步的那条隧道，其实是一个野生动物通道。

sentences.en: Oh, OK.
sentences.zh: 哦，好的。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对，对，对。

sentences.en: And this one specifically is a wildlife underpass.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，这是一个野生动物地下通道。

sentences.en: And it's in California, further up the 101 up near Gilroy, a few miles south of San Jose.
sentences.zh: 它位于加利福尼亚州，沿着101号公路往上走，在吉尔罗伊附近，圣何塞以南几英里处。

sentences.en: And this is the same 101 that runs through L.A.
sentences.zh: 这就是穿过洛杉矶的那条101号公路，

sentences.en: and is a big problem for, you know, for mountain lions in the area that we were talking about in the story.
sentences.zh: 这也是我们在故事中讨论过的，给当地美洲狮造成巨大麻烦的那条路。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，没错。

sentences.en: So this underpass was built to seemingly help with that habitat fracturing and to prevent roadkill,
sentences.zh: 所以修建这个地下通道，显然是为了帮助缓解栖息地割裂的问题，并防止发生道路动物撞击事故，

sentences.en: not to mention all the accidents and deaths that vehicle animal collisions create, you know.
sentences.zh: 更不用说车与动物相撞所造成的所有事故和死亡了。

sentences.en: Which is not a small number.
sentences.zh: 这可不是个小数字。

sentences.en: No, not at all.
sentences.zh: 不，一点也不少。

sentences.en: Research shows that there are between one and two million vehicle and large animal collisions every year in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 研究表明，在美国，每年发生一到两百万起机动车与大型动物相撞的事故。

sentences.en: And thousands of those accidents result in some sort of human injury and sometimes even in human deaths.
sentences.zh: 其中数千起事故导致某种形式的人员受伤，有时甚至造成人员死亡。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And almost always the death of the animal, too.
sentences.zh: 而且几乎总是伴随着动物的死亡。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: So what we're seeing in this video with this underpass and this coyote and this badger, is this typical behavior for these two?
sentences.zh: 那么我们在视频中看到的这个地下通道，以及这只郊狼和这只獾，这种行为对它们来说是典型的吗？

sentences.en: Or is the underpass like causing them to behave differently?
sentences.zh: 还是说地下通道导致它们的行为发生了变化？

sentences.en: Or what is going on?
sentences.zh: 或者说到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: You know, that's a great question.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是个好问题。

sentences.en: Coyotes and badgers were not widely known to hunt together until kind of recently.
sentences.zh: 直到最近，人们才知道郊狼和獾会结伴捕猎。

sentences.en: And this video shows that dynamic because a coyote can chase and catch its prey and a badger can dig if the prey hits underground.
sentences.zh: 这段视频展示了这种动态，因为郊狼可以追赶并抓住猎物，而如果猎物钻到地下，獾就可以进行挖掘。

sentences.en: So the video helped show scientists this collaboration among species.
sentences.zh: 所以这段视频帮助科学家们了解了物种之间的这种协作。

sentences.en: So it's like, you know, they're doing what they normally do.
sentences.zh: 所以这就好比，你知道，它们在做它们平时做的事情。

sentences.en: They just happen to be doing it while crossing under the 101.
sentences.zh: 它们只是碰巧在穿过101号公路下方时做了这件事。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: If anything, the underpass facilitated them to go on and do the thing that they do.
sentences.zh: 如果非要说有什么影响的话，那就是地下通道为它们继续做它们本就在做的事提供了便利。

sentences.en: And, you know, there's a lot of videos out there documenting animals using a crossing.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，有很多视频记录了动物使用通道的情况。

sentences.en: There's this video of a Florida panther and its kittens going under an interstate in Florida and a bobcat and her kittens sort of excitedly prancing under a bridge in Salinas,
sentences.zh: 比如有一段视频记录了一只佛罗里达美洲狮带着它的幼崽穿过佛罗里达州的一条州际公路，还有一只山猫带着幼崽在加利福尼亚州

sentences.en: California.
sentences.zh: 萨利纳斯的桥下兴奋地小跑。

sentences.en: I mean, I would imagine just like turning P22 into a celebrity to make a wildlife crossing happen that a video like this, you know, reinforces that this is an issue,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我想就像把P-22变成名人来促成野生动物通道的建设一样，像这样的视频，你知道，巩固了这是一个问题，

sentences.en: that there should be awareness of it.
sentences.zh: 人们应该对此有所认识。

sentences.en: And when it's solved, it's extremely adorable.
sentences.zh: 当问题解决时，这一切又极其可爱。

sentences.en: And so knowing these stories and seeing these videos like this, is it really changing the way people are thinking about wildlife crossings when they're doing new construction?
sentences.zh: 所以了解这些故事并看到这样的视频，真的在改变人们在进行新建设时对野生动物通道的看法吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Actually, just recently,
sentences.zh: 事实上，就在最近，

sentences.en: a bill was passed in California that makes the California Department of Transportation prioritize crossings when they're working on or building new roadways.
sentences.zh: 加利福尼亚州通过了一项法案，规定加州交通运输局在修建或改造新道路时，必须优先考虑野生动物通道。

sentences.en: That sounds like a good thing.
sentences.zh: 听起来这是一件好事。

sentences.en: It is a very good thing.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是一件非常好的事。

sentences.en: But, like, the real solution would be to stop building so many damn roads in the first place so that these animals wouldn't have to cross our busy highways.
sentences.zh: 但是，真正的解决方法其实是首先停止修建那么多该死的道路，这样这些动物就不用穿过我们繁忙的高速公路了。

sentences.en: That's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: This doesn't have to be a problem that we solve.
sentences.zh: 这本来不一定是我们必须去解决的问题。

sentences.en: This could be just a problem that we just don't create.
sentences.zh: 这本可以是一个我们根本就不会制造出来的问题。

sentences.en: There you go.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Well, thanks again for sharing the story with us, Rox.
sentences.zh: 好了，罗克斯，非常感谢你和我们分享这个故事。

sentences.en: I mean, we really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们真的很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you, Roman.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，罗曼。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We're part of the Stitcher and SiriusXM podcast family, now headquartered six blocks north in the Pandora building in beautiful Uptown, Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 我们是 Stitcher 和 SiriusXM 播客家族的一部分，总部现在位于加利福尼亚州奥克兰市美丽的上城区的潘多拉大厦向北六个街区。

sentences.zh: 你可以在 Facebook 上找到这个节目并参与讨论。

sentences.zh: 你可以在 Twitter 上@我（@Roman Mars）以及节目（@99pi.org）。

sentences.en: We're on Instagram, Reddit, and TikTok, too.
sentences.zh: 我们也在 Instagram、Reddit 和 TikTok 上。

sentences.zh: 你可以在 99pi.org 上找到我喜欢其他 Stitcher 节目的链接，以及 99pi 以往的每一期节目。
